method: Arbitrary user-requested visual relocation to Northern Gyeonggi. No search, ranking, route study, or suitability analysis was performed.
selected_reason: Virtual training scenario background; coordinate supplied as a visual reference.

distant_departure.representation: Launch areas lie 3 km north of the Natural Earth DMZ northern limit (North Korean side); approach corridors are synthetic training assumptions and the 40-50 km transit is time-compressed. Terrain beyond the local 10 km DEM is not modelled.

limitations: Not an existing air base, surveyed parcel, approved development, or feasible airport site.
No cadastral, flood, obstacle, wind, land-use, construction, or military siting assessment.
The marked virtual redevelopment polygon replaces internal map features and is leveled for display; surrounding elevation is sampled public DEM.
A uniform display-only altitude lift keeps moving aerial markers visible above the relief; it changes no observation, authored trajectory, speed, or agent evidence.
